checkpoint_policy: fixed final step; no development checkpoint selection
replay_policy: 50% shared variable dual, 25% original dual pair, 25% original single pair
budget_policy: 800 updates and 1800 images per arm; fresh sampling/order seeds with same source pose pool; report actual tokens as single-mouse aspect ratios may shift

acceptance.reference: original checkpoint, not weakened fine-tuned control

replication_policy: Both fresh seeds must pass all original gates individually, not merely the average. No production promotion.
